_note: APPROVED by the owner 2026-10-08 (E6), evidence labels unchanged. Source of truth for the Claim Guide 'your figure' line. No figure ships until its 'approved' is a date. Every figure: value, effective date, primary letter, and the evidence level actually seen. Evidence: LETTER_TEXT = the primary letter's own text was read; HANDBOOK_ONLY = the P&A Handbook 2023 prints the letter number and the rates but the letter text was not read; WEB_SECONDARY = news or department pages quote the order, primary text not read. OWNER_CONFIRMED = the owner stated it (with a `confirmed` date) without a document.

da_step.decided_by: owner 2026-10-07 (additive, not compounding; no difference below DA 100%)
da_step.authority: MoD letter 12630/Mov C/242/D(Mov)/2017 dt 15-09-2017, para 2(iv) ('lump sum amount will increase by 25 percent whenever DA increases by 50 percent')

food_rate.assumption: full day (over 12 hours away), before taxes
food_rate.authority: MoD letter 12630/Mov C/242/D(Mov)/2017 dt 15-09-2017, Table E(i)
food_rate.assumption_note: Owner kept "before taxes" on 2026-10-08. The letter text read does not mention taxes; the wording rests on the owner decision (EP item).

ctg.assumption: move of 20 km or more, not to or from Andaman, Nicobar or Lakshadweep (100% there)

transport_allowance.note: Base plus DA on it (base x (1 + DA/100)). No 25% step: the same shape Pay Audit uses in TptaEntitlementAuditor.
transport_allowance.evidence_detail: Handbook on Pay & Allowances 2023, ch. Additions to Pay, para 14 prints the letter number, 'effective from 01 July 2017' and these rates. The letter text itself is not in the source folder.
transport_allowance.city_note: Pay Audit tptaCity is a class (HIGHER or OTHER) recovered from the payslip TPTA base, null at level 14+. The class is used directly (owner 2026-10-08).

hra.note: The line restates the rate the payslip's HRA / basic ratio implies; it is a cross-check, not a new entitlement. A step applies when DA is at or above 'from_da_percent'.
hra.authority: MoF Dept of Expenditure OM 2(5)/2017-E.II(B) dt 07-07-2017
hra.evidence_detail: Handbook 2023 'HRA as per 7th CPC Orders' prints the 24/16/8 rates 'w.e.f. 01 July 2017' and the 27/18/9 (DA 25%) and 30/20/10 (DA 50%) revisions, and names the OM. OM text not read. The step dates (01-07-2021, 01-01-2024) were corroborated on the web (gconnect.in, a CAG circular) and confirmed by the owner on 2026-10-08: OWNER_CONFIRMED.
hra.mismatch_rule: If the payslip ratio is a valid rate but not the rate for that class at the payslip DA, the line is hidden (owner 2026-10-08).
